dialogues.speaker: Read
dialogues.text: "For those who just happen to be passing through, or if you've been active in this area for a long while: Eyes up, and stay sharp."

dialogues.speaker: Read
dialogues.text: "There was a cunning criminal syndicate operating in this area who would use weapons that leave no trace to harm people's Saurian companions, then capture them and sell them off for a profit!"

response.speaker: Read
response.text: #"Fortunately, the brave and resourceful {NICKNAME}, {M#his}{F#her} companion Paimon, and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} acted decisively..."

response.speaker: Read
response.text: "They dealt a heavy blow to this syndicate, and rescued many of the captured animals!"

response.speaker: Read
response.text: "However, it is unclear if these villains still have accomplices at large, or when they will come out of the woodwork once again..."

response.speaker: Read
response.text: "Soon after, each tribe will take turns sending out patrols to keep the peace in this area, continue tracking down clues about said syndicate, and do their best to thoroughly wipe them out."

response.speaker: Read
response.text: "As such, friends, please refrain from resting out in the open. It's safest if you go inside a camp — and more comfortable, too!"

response.speaker: Read
response.text: #"May the luck and courage of {NICKNAME}, Paimon, and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} protect you all also!"
